title: Vendor Analytics — Revenue & Orders Chart
description: Powers the Revenue & orders composed chart (area = revenue, line = orders) and the total-revenue figure above it. Filtered by calendar year only — not by the page start_date/end_date. Default year is the current year.

endpoint.auth: Vendor Bearer token + Application-Token (same as other /api/vendor/* routes)

query.year: YYYY. Required. Calendar year. Frontend defaults to the current year.

fields.total_revenue: Sum of series[].revenue for that year.
fields.total_orders: Sum of series[].orders for that year.
fields.series: Always 12 monthly points, January through December, chronological. Use 0 for months with no sales and for future months in the current year.

series_item.label: Short month name: Jan, Feb, Mar, Apr, May, Jun, Jul, Aug, Sep, Oct, Nov, Dec.
series_item.revenue: Gross completed-order sales in that month. Number, not a formatted string.
series_item.orders: Completed order count in that month. Integer.
